messages:
maria: Quick ops ask — need to enable a per-tenant flag for ACME (tenant_id=acme-enterprise). Contract gating requires VIP feature only for them. Plan: staged canary to 5% of their users, tenant-level allowlist for VIP users, and a kill-switch. Anyone see any blockers?

ashok: Are we identifying users by user_id or account-level sessions? For per-tenant gating we should scope by tenant_id + user_id when doing percent rollouts. Also need a contract lookup to block non-contracted orgs at the middleware.

jess: +1. For canary do user-level percent not session-level. Need a config example, e.g.:

```json
{
  "flag": "new_vip_ui",
  "scope": "tenant:acme-enterprise",
  "allowlist": ["user:1001", "user:1002"],
  "canary": {"percent": 5, "unit": "user"},
  "kill_switch": true
}
```

luke: Add runtime guardrails: circuit-breaker if p99 latency > 2s for 5min, and auto-fallback to baseline UI. Also tag logs with tenant_id+flag so SLO dashboard can slice.

samir: I can wire the dashboard. We need per-tenant audit events (who toggled, when), and an alert if error-rate delta > 1% vs baseline. Also recommend a short-lived canary window (2-4 hours) with manual approve before full enable.

product-ally: Business note — confirm contract enforcement: any accidental enable for other tenants is a compliance risk. We need a code-owner + docs + test plan. Who owns rollout sign-off?

maria: I'll own the PR and rollout sign-off. @ashok will review gating middleware. @jess pls add the canary monitor and a small eval prompt set. I'll aim to flip the first 5% canary Mon 09:00 PT after QA. Thanks :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: draft flag config saved to staging at /flags/new_vip_ui (staging). Run `make test-flags` and ping when green.

luke: one more: add a short circuit in the client so we can quickly stop the feature for acme if we see regressions — client-side kill-switch + server-side toggle.

maria: ack — will include both. Posting PR link when ready.
